description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - seat catch: finding your seat after the ticket check is a short-term-memory trap - row and seat seen once, forgotten twice on the way in, ticket stub checked again and again with your head down. You glance at the stub and hold still: a telephoto photo is read by the host model into zone / row / seat, you verify it huge on the confirm screen (steppers fix a misread), and only your OK keeps it - in session memory only, never written anywhere, gone when you sit down or close the agent. Then it guides you RELATIVELY, row by row: you photo each row sign as you pass it, it reads the current row and tells you the difference (3 rows to go, keep forward / one row too far, go back / this is your row), and inside the row it reads the nearest seat-back number and gives the count difference toward bigger or smaller numbers. It has no indoor positioning of any kind - no map, no arrow to your seat, no claim to know where you are: every hint is the difference between the seat you confirmed and the number you just read. A steady nod (twice) or SIT means you judge you are seated; the target is wiped and a done screen says so.
name: seat-catch
